verseText: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
meaning: If we trust in Jesus, we can trust that God will always be with us. No matter what troubles we face, we have no reason to fear. Our mighty God is always near to give us what we need.

recall.question: Why does God tell His people not to be afraid?
choices: Our fears are no big deal

meaning.question: God promises to uphold His people, to support or hold us up. What does God promise to do when we're struggling?
choices: Leave us to figure it out

application.prompt: Have you ever felt afraid because something seemed too hard for you? God doesn't promise that we'll never face trouble, but He does promise to strengthen and help His people! When you feel scared or overwhelmed, remember that you don't have to face your troubles alone. God is with you, and he can do the impossible!
